faq.lead: The essentials to know before you enter the realm.
faq.q1: Is Nexus Dominion free to play?
faq.a1: Yes. The full game is playable without paying anything. Optional gems — earned in play and also sold in the Premium Mint — pay for mounts, auction bids, renames and timer skips. Gear, dungeons, guild features and leaderboards are all reachable through play.
faq.q2: Do I need to download anything?
faq.a2: No installer. The whole client is a single web page; it loads in Chrome, Firefox, Safari and Edge on desktop, and works on iOS Safari and Android Chrome with a touch-optimised layout.
faq.q3: How long is one play session?
faq.a3: Ten to twenty minutes for a focused session: one daily, two or three hunting runs, a dungeon stage. Combat is turn-based and resolves in under thirty seconds per fight.
faq.q4: Who decides the outcome of a fight?
faq.a4: The server. Combat, loot, economy and progression are resolved and validated on the server — the client only renders and sends intents.
faq.a5: English, Bulgarian and Italian — the whole interface in all three.
